name: seg7
title: Coal-SEG7 — 7-segment decoder
description: Build a 7-segment decoder: a 4-bit binary input maps to the 7 active-high segment lines (seg[6:0] = {g,f,e,d,c,b,a}). Testbench prints seg7:PASS.
context: Combinational. Encoding: seg[0]=a (top), seg[1]=b (top-right), seg[2]=c (bottom-right), seg[3]=d (bottom), seg[4]=e (bottom-left), seg[5]=f (top-left), seg[6]=g (middle). Digits: 0->7'b0111111 (0x3F), 1->0x06, 2->0x5B, 3->0x4F, 4->0x66, 5->0x6D, 6->0x7D, 7->0x07, 8->0x7F, 9->0x6F. Testbench CHECKs bin=0->0x3F and bin=1->0x06. print seg7:PASS.
